meta.name: E-Commerce Platform
meta.summary: Complete UML design for a modern e-commerce platform: customer management, order processing, payment gateway, inventory, and recommendation engine.

documents.name: 01-Project-Overview.md
documents.content:
# E-Commerce Platform

## Overview
A modern e-commerce platform supporting multi-vendor marketplace, real-time inventory management, and AI-powered recommendations.

## Stakeholders
- Customers (B2C)
- Vendors (Sellers)
- Admin (Platform Ops)
- Payment Gateway Providers
- Logistics Partners

## Key Features
- User registration and authentication
- Product catalog with search and filtering
- Shopping cart and checkout
- Payment processing (credit card, e-wallet, COD)
- Order tracking
- Vendor dashboard
- Admin analytics
- Recommendation engine
- Review and rating system

documents.name: 02-Tech-Stack.md
documents.content:
# Tech Stack

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Spring Boot, Java 17
- Database: PostgreSQL, Redis (caching)
- Message Queue: RabbitMQ
- Search: Elasticsearch
- Storage: AWS S3
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes
- Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana
